name: std/compiler
description: The Fox self-hosting Active Oberon toolchain: frontends (Oberon/C#), semantic checker, intermediate + backends (AMD64/ARM/TRM/interpreter), assemblers, disassemblers, object-file/linker, the older PC* code generators, and CPU instruction decoders.
residual: Re-homed from the misc pile: the 8 code-generator/decoder backends (AMD64Decoder, ARMDecoder, I386Decoder, PCG386, PCGAMD64, PCGARM, PCA386, PCOFPE) plus the whole PC*/ASM* family — they are the compiler, not misc.

UNPLACED (a few Fox tools drag them): the GUI documentation/progtool front-ends pull WM* (WMComponents/Dialogs/Editors/TextView/Trees/…) and MemoryReader/PersistentObjects/Versioning/TestSuite. Split those interactive tools into an apps area so the toolchain core stays headless; then this package can go stable.
